summary: The bbl, debt, document, and party-search commands join the Legals, Master, and Parties datasets locally by document_id; the shared SoQL/fan-out helpers live in acris_join.go.
reason: ACRIS publishes its records as four separate NYC Open Data (Socrata) datasets with no server-side join endpoint, so a regen that only lists each dataset would lose every cross-dataset command. The durable contract is: resolve a BBL or document/party key in one dataset, collect distinct document IDs, then chunk-fetch the related rows from the others.
